legend: Grade 2 chondrosarcoma with increased cellularity and myxoid matrix changes.
Grade 3 chondrosarcoma with increased cellularity, myxoid matrix changes, and spindled cells. Mitoses are easily found.

diagnosis: Secondary peripheral chondrosarcoma arising in a patient with multiple osteochondromas
legend: Conventional radiograph (left) and surgical specimen (right) of the right proximal fibula. Note the thickness of the cartilaginous cap (> 2 cm), flaring of the cortex (macro), and indistinct margins with irregular mineralization (radiograph).

diagnosis: Secondary peripheral chondrosarcoma arising in a patient with multiple osteochondromas
legend: Discrete peripheral nodules of cartilage are embedded in the soft tissue at the periphery of the lesion. These features explain the irregular margins and the possibility of local recurrence when the lesion is resected with inadequate surgical margins.
